steps.description:
Show that your robot can do the following using one Button:
1. When Button A is pressed, the LCD will display text "Buy 1 get 1 free!" for 2 seconds.

Hint:
1. Use Forever Loop

The program plays continuously until the stop Button in the blockly is pressed
The display text must be switchable without stopping the program

Show that your robot can do the following using two Buttons:
1. When Button A is pressed, the LCD will display text "Buy 1 get 1 free!" for 2 seconds.
2. When Button B is pressed, the LCD will display text "Buy 2 for $10" for 2 seconds.

Hint:
1. Use Forever Loop

The program plays continuously until the stop Button in the blockly is pressed
The display text must be switchable without stopping the program

Show that your robot can do the following using two Buttons:
1. When Button A is pressed, the LCD will display text "Buy 1 get 1 free!" for 2 seconds.
2. When Button B is pressed, the LCD will display text "Buy 2 for $10" for 2 seconds."
3. When both Button A and B are pressed, the LCD will display text "Free!!" for 2 seconds

Hint:
1. Use Forever Loop

The program plays continuously until the stop Button in the blockly is pressed
The display text must be switchable without stopping the program

Show that your robot can do the following using two Buttons:
1. When Button A is pressed and released, the LCD will display text "Buy 1 get 1 free!" on the LCD until Button B is pressed
2. When Button B is pressed and released, the LCD will display text "Buy 2 for $10" for 2 seconds.
3. When both Button A and B are pressed and released, the LCD will display text "Free!!" for 2 seconds

Hint:
1. Use Forever Loop

The program plays continuously until the stop Button in the blockly is pressed
The display text must be switchable without stopping the program

Show that your robot can do the following using two Buttons:
1. When Button A is pressed and released, the LCD will display text "Buy 1 get 1 free!" until Button B is pressed
2. When Button B is pressed and released, the LCD will display text "Buy 2 for $10" until Button A is pressed
3. When both Button A and B are pressed and released, the LCD will display text "Free!!" for 2 seconds

Hint:
1. Use Forever Loop

The program plays continuously until the stop Button in the blockly is pressed
The display text must be switchable without stopping the program

Show that your robot can do the following using two Buttons:
1. When Button A is pressed and released, the LCD will display text "Buy 1 get 1 free!" until Button B is pressed
2. When Button B is pressed and released, the LCD will display text "Buy 2 for $10" until Button A is pressed
3. When both Button A and B are pressed and released, the LCD will display text "Free!! until Button A or B is pressed

Hint:
1. Use Forever Loop

The program plays continuously until the stop Button in the blockly is pressed
The display text must be switchable without stopping the program

Show that your robot can do the following using three Buttons:
1. When Button A is pressed and released, the LCD will display text "Buy 1 get 1 free!" until Button B is pressed
2. When Button B is pressed and released, the LCD will display text "Buy 2 for $10" until Button A is pressed
3. When both Button A and B are pressed and released, the LCD will display text "Free!! until Button A or B is pressed.
4. When Button C is pressed and released, the program will stop.

Hint:
1. Use Forever Loop
2. Break out of Loop / Until Loop

The program plays continuously until the stop Button in the blockly is pressed
The display text must be switchable without stopping the program
